notes.title: The Eternal Pyre!
notes.content:
Zone 8: The Eternal Pyre is now available! Continue your journey with your heroes on a perilous journey upward to the lair of Erebus!
Bug Fixes!
[list]
[*]Heroes should no longer attack automatically at the beginning of a battle before the player has done anything
[*]Fainted or invisible Mojos in zone 6 should now stay gone completely and not revive themselves/take actions while not being in the fight
[*]'Loot All' would sometimes give fake extra spirit stones that the player could not use. The player should now always see and receive the correct amount. 
[*]Images in Maghmell were off center and should now be corrected
[*]Some players were getting stuck on purchasing Longshot in tutorial. Players should now be able to continue as normal.
[*]'Close' button should now always perform correctly on mobile devices.
[*]Delayed attacks such as Areesi or Trixy's should no longer be cancelled when killing the same enemy hero.
[*]Spectral Acheron should always be visible in the summoning tab.
[*]Minor text issues in hero descriptions fixed
[*]Immune should now be immune and increase damage effects should not be able to hurt them.
[b]Improvements![/b]

[*]Steam users now have the option to use Facebook linking
[*]Steam users should see an improvement to UI and sizing
